sentences.japanese: 空気が抜けるにつれて風船は徐々に降りてきた。
sentences.english: The balloon descended gradually as the air came out.

sentences.japanese: 近年、物価が徐々に上がっている。
sentences.english: Prices have been gradually rising in recent years.

sentences.japanese: 我々の関係は徐々に冷えていくようだ。
sentences.english: Relations between us seem to be on the ebb.

sentences.japanese: 駅にもどるには遠い道のりであったが、徐々にその古い荷馬車は近づいて行った。
sentences.english: Although it was a long way back to the station, little by little the old wagon drew near.

sentences.japanese: バスは徐々にスピードを上げた。
sentences.english: The bus picked up the speed gradually.
